title: Beyond Benchmark Accuracy: A Diagnostic Test for LLM Chemical Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. translated_title: 超越基准准确率：大语言模型化学预测的诊断性测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在化学预测基准测试中已取得出色表现。然而，现有的评估方法通常直接提供目标实体的身份信息，这使得我们难以判断模型的预测究竟源自可迁移的结构-性质推理能力，还是依赖于与目标相关的上下文信息或记忆检索。我们提出了身份遮蔽推理诊断框架，用于在目标实体身份信息被隐藏的情况下评估化学预测模型。在该框架中，目标不再由其实体身份直接定义，而是由一个已知的源实体和一个明确的结构编辑操作来定义。这一设置在保留确定目标所需信息的同时，减少了模型获取目标身份线索的机会。我们在涵盖气味预测、分子性质预测、逆合成等六项任务上对该框架进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出身份遮蔽推理诊断框架，通过隐藏目标实体身份、以已知源实体加显式结构编辑操作来定义目标，从而区分大语言模型的化学预测能力究竟来自真正的结构-性质推理，还是来自上下文信息或记忆检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework that hides target entity identity and defines targets via a known source entity plus explicit structural edits, distinguishing whether LLM chemical predictions arise from genuine structure-property reasoning or from contextual cues and memorization.
